Any inferred status can be overridden, a boolean
measure set to Partial included. The rule constrains the
The linked projects come with the check-out, every one
of them picked to go with the goal, and whichever should
stay is left active. An archived goal still exists, so a
project kept active is not orphaned. The goal's progress
measures and their check-in history go with it unasked.
What a follow-up inherits, resets and back-references is
fixed, so the sitting says only whether to create one.
Amending it afterwards is editing a goal, on the goals
One request carries everything the sitting decided, and
the system executes it in one go: the check-out stored,
the archiving where it was asked for, the follow-up
created, the outcome reported. Nothing is left to decide
This is what the system observed, which the user then
judges: the statuses are inferred and never decided. The
goal and its measures came with the goals, so nothing
re-reads them; their linked projects did not, and the
sitting settles the archiving on them. A check-out is
available at any time, with or without a horizon.
The check-out record stays attached to the goal,
archived or not, and unarchiving never revokes it. The
follow-up inherits the theme and the linked ideas, carries
the objective over as a continuation, takes the Partial
and Missed measures with their progress reset,
advances a horizon that existed, drops the check-out
notes, and keeps the link back to the check-out that
